# Purpose
This script keeps the comprehensive Divvy trips dataset (June 2013 onward) current. Run it whenever Divvy posts new monthly files to the [system data bucket](https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com/index.html). Each run:

1. Loads the comprehensive trip-level data frames from their own RData file.
2. Lists the monthly files in the Divvy S3 bucket and keeps only those not yet added.
3. Downloads, formats and joins each new month to Chicago community areas, then appends it to the comprehensive data frames.
4. Saves the updated comprehensive data frames to their RData file.
5. Rebuilds the summary tables and saves them to `divvy_trips_summary_tables_latest.RData`, the file loaded when rendering `Exercise_02.qmd`.

The comprehensive RData file holds two trip-level data frames:

- `divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all`: every trip with valid start and end coordinates. It has no duration field and is used for trip counts.
- `divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration`: the subset of trips with a plausible duration, with the trip length in minutes in `trip_minutes`. It is used for all duration (minutes per trip) summaries.

The file also holds `divvy_files_processed`, the log of monthly files already appended. It keeps a file from being added twice.

# Settings
```{r}
#| label: settings

data_dir <- "exercises/Exercise_02/data"
raw_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "divvy_raw") # downloaded zip files are kept here

# comprehensive trip-level data frames (not loaded by Exercise_02.qmd)
comprehensive_file <- file.path(data_dir, "divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all.RData")

# summary tables loaded by Exercise_02.qmd
summary_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Exercise_02.RData")

# legacy comprehensive file, used only the first time this script runs
legacy_file <- file.path(data_dir, "divvy_trips_latest_ca_all_2013_202608.RData")
legacy_object <- "divvy_trips_latest_ca_all_2013_202608"

divvy_bucket <- "https://divvy-tripdata.s3.amazonaws.com"

# trips shorter or longer than these limits are left out of the duration data frame
# (false starts, re-docks and bikes kept out overnight or lost)
min_trip_minutes <- 1
max_trip_minutes <- 24 * 60

# columns kept in the duration data frame for new trips
duration_cols <- c("rideable_type", "member_casual", "year", "yearmonth", "date",
                   "weekday", "hour_start", "hour_end",
                   "start_comarea_id", "start_comarea_name",
                   "end_comarea_id", "end_comarea_name",
                   "trip_minutes")

dir.create(raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
options(timeout = max(600, getOption("timeout"))) # monthly zip files are large
```

# Functions for data development
```{r}
#| label: functions

# list monthly trip files (YYYYMM-divvy-tripdata.zip) in the Divvy S3 bucket
list_divvy_files <- function(bucket = divvy_bucket) {
  listing <- read_xml(bucket) %>% xml_ns_strip()
  tibble(file = xml_text(xml_find_all(listing, "//Contents/Key")),
         last_modified = ymd_hms(xml_text(xml_find_all(listing, "//Contents/LastModified")))) %>%
    filter(str_detect(file, "^\\d{6}-divvy-tripdata\\.zip$")) %>%
    mutate(file_month = str_sub(file, 1, 6)) %>%
    arrange(file_month)
}

# download (if needed), unzip and read one monthly file
read_divvy_file <- function(afile) {
  azip <- file.path(raw_dir, afile)
  if (!file.exists(azip)) {
    download.file(paste0(divvy_bucket, "/", afile), azip, mode = "wb")
  }
  acsv <- unzip(azip, list = TRUE)$Name %>%
    str_subset("^(?!__MACOSX).*\\.csv$")
  unzip(azip, files = acsv, exdir = raw_dir)
  # read times as text and parse below: some months (e.g., 202106, 202303) use
  # formats that readr's default guesser mishandles
  trips <- read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, acsv),
                    col_types = cols(started_at = col_character(),
                                     ended_at = col_character(),
                                     start_lat = col_double(),
                                     start_lng = col_double(),
                                     end_lat = col_double(),
                                     end_lng = col_double(),
                                     .default = col_character()))
  file.remove(file.path(raw_dir, acsv))
  trips
}

# derive the fields used throughout the exercise; keep trip_minutes for now
format_divvy_trips <- function(trips) {
  trips %>%
    mutate(started_at = ymd_hms(started_at, truncated = 1, quiet = TRUE),
           ended_at = ymd_hms(ended_at, truncated = 1, quiet = TRUE)) %>%
    drop_na(started_at, start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng) %>%
    transmute(rideable_type,
              hour_start = hour(started_at),
              hour_end = hour(ended_at),
              year = year(started_at),
              date = format(started_at, "%m/%d/%Y"),
              yearmonth = format(started_at, "%Y-%m"),
              weekday = weekdays(started_at),
              trip_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(ended_at, started_at, units = "mins")),
              start_lat,
              start_lng,
              end_lat,
              end_lng,
              member_casual)
}

# community area id of each point (NA outside Chicago); takes the first match so
# points on a shared boundary are not duplicated
point_comarea <- function(lng, lat, areas) {
  pts <- st_as_sf(tibble(lng, lat), coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(st_crs(areas))
  areas$comarea_id[vapply(st_intersects(pts, areas), `[`, integer(1), 1)]
}

# add start and end community areas to formatted trips
join_comareas <- function(trips, areas) {
  trips %>%
    mutate(start_comarea_id = point_comarea(start_lng, start_lat, areas),
           end_comarea_id = point_comarea(end_lng, end_lat, areas)) %>%
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(areas) %>%
                select(start_comarea_id = comarea_id, start_comarea_name = comarea_name),
              by = "start_comarea_id") %>%
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(areas) %>%
                select(end_comarea_id = comarea_id, end_comarea_name = comarea_name),
              by = "end_comarea_id")
}

# trip durations as plain numeric minutes; a difftime (in any units) or lubridate
# duration is converted using its own units, so values stored in seconds become minutes
as_minutes <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "difftime")) as.numeric(x, units = "mins")
  else if (inherits(x, "Duration")) as.numeric(x, "minutes")
  else as.numeric(x)
}

# keep trips with plausible durations for the duration data frame
filter_duration <- function(trips) {
  trips %>%
    filter(between(trip_minutes, min_trip_minutes, max_trip_minutes))
}
```

# Community areas
```{r}
#| label: import community areas
#| output: false

# import City of Chicago community areas (N=77) GEOJSON from Chicago data portal and transform into standard geographic projection (epsg:3435)
community_areas <- st_read("https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/igwz-8jzy.geojson") %>%
  st_transform(3435) %>%
  mutate(comarea_id = as.numeric(area_numbe),
         comarea_name = str_to_title(community)) %>%
  select(comarea_id, comarea_name)
```

# Load comprehensive data frames
The first time this script runs, the comprehensive RData file does not exist yet. The script then builds both data frames from the legacy comprehensive data frame. That data frame stores durations as `trip_duration` (a difftime), which is converted to `trip_minutes`.

```{r}
#| label: load comprehensive data frames

if (file.exists(comprehensive_file)) {
  load(comprehensive_file)
} else {
  load(legacy_file)
  legacy <- get(legacy_object)
  rm(list = legacy_object)

  if (!"trip_minutes" %in% names(legacy)) {
    stopifnot(inherits(legacy$trip_duration, "difftime"))
    legacy <- legacy %>%
      mutate(trip_minutes = as_minutes(trip_duration)) %>%
      select(-trip_duration)
  } else {
    legacy$trip_minutes <- as_minutes(legacy$trip_minutes)
  }

  divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration <- legacy %>%
    filter_duration() %>%
    select(any_of(duration_cols))
  divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all <- legacy %>%
    select(-trip_minutes)
  rm(legacy)
  gc()
}

# trip_minutes must be plain numeric minutes: a difftime or duration column keeps
# its class when summed, and the summary tables then cannot fill in 0 or NA
if (is.object(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration$trip_minutes)) {
  divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration$trip_minutes <-
    as_minutes(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration$trip_minutes)
}

# log of monthly files already appended; if missing, infer it from the months
# present in the data (monthly files begin April 2020)
if (!exists("divvy_files_processed")) {
  divvy_files_processed <- divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all %>%
    distinct(yearmonth) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    filter(yearmonth >= "2020-04") %>%
    mutate(file = paste0(str_remove(yearmonth, "-"), "-divvy-tripdata.zip")) %>%
    pull(file) %>%
    sort()
}
```

# Find new monthly files
Only files for months after the latest file already processed are added. Earlier files that are not in the log (e.g., months covered by a quarterly file) are never re-added.

```{r}
#| label: find new monthly files

divvy_files <- list_divvy_files()
last_file_month <- max(str_sub(divvy_files_processed, 1, 6))

new_files <- divvy_files %>%
  filter(file_month > last_file_month,
         !file %in% divvy_files_processed) %>%
  pull(file)

new_files
```

# Append new months
Each file is processed on its own to keep memory use down. Both data frames are then appended in a single step.

```{r}
#| label: append new months

if (length(new_files) > 0) {
  new_trips <- map(new_files, function(afile) {
    message("Processing ", afile)
    read_divvy_file(afile) %>%
      format_divvy_trips() %>%
      join_comareas(community_areas)
  }) %>%
    list_rbind()

  # match each data frame's existing columns
  divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all <- divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all %>%
    bind_rows(new_trips %>%
                select(any_of(names(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all))))

  divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration <- divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration %>%
    bind_rows(new_trips %>%
                filter_duration() %>%
                select(any_of(names(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration))))

  divvy_files_processed <- sort(c(divvy_files_processed, new_files))
  rm(new_trips)
  gc()
}

# latest month in the data, used to label figures in Exercise_02.qmd
divvy_data_through <- max(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all$yearmonth, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Save comprehensive data frames
This file is separate from the summary tables file that `Exercise_02.qmd` loads.

```{r}
#| label: save comprehensive data frames

if (length(new_files) > 0 || !file.exists(comprehensive_file)) {
  save(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all,
       divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration,
       divvy_files_processed,
       divvy_data_through,
       file = comprehensive_file)
}
```

# Summary tables

## Divvy Trips
Trip counts come from `divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all`. Duration measures come from `divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration`, so `trips` in the duration tables counts only trips with a valid duration.

Grouping the ~60 million trip-level rows is the slow step (the `transmute()` and `mutate()` calls below run on the small grouped results and cost little). Each trip-level data frame is therefore collapsed once with `data.table`, a few million rows at a time to limit memory use, to trip counts (and minutes) per month, date and start or end community area, which is a few hundred thousand rows. Every summary table is then built from these collapsed tables with `dplyr`. Groups with missing values are kept while collapsing, so the totals match grouping the trip-level rows directly.


```{r}
#| label: load latest comprehensive data frames

# if changes/updates
load(file = comprehensive_file)

# if no changes/updates
# load(file="exercises/Exercise_02/data/divvy_trips_latest_ca_all.RData")

#   select(any_of(c("rideable_type", "member_casual", "year", "yearmonth", "date",
#                   "weekday", "hour_start", "hour_end",
#                   "start_comarea_id", "start_comarea_name",
#                   "end_comarea_id", "end_comarea_name")),
#          trip_duration) %>%
#   mutate(trip_minutes = as.numeric(trip_duration, units = "mins")) %>%
#   select(-trip_duration) %>%
#   filter(trip_minutes >= 1, trip_minutes <= 24 * 60)
```


```{r}
#| label: collapse trip-level data frames

# rows grouped at a time; data.table needs working memory in proportion to the rows
# it groups, so lower this if it reports "Unable to allocate" errors
chunk_rows <- 5e6

# trips (and minutes) per group of key columns, as a data.table
count_trips <- function(dt, keys, duration) {
  if (duration) {
    dt[, .(trips = .N, trip_duration_mins = sum(trip_minutes)), by = keys]
  } else {
    dt[, .(trips = .N), by = keys]
  }
}

# trips (and minutes) per yearmonth, date and start or end community area, as a tibble.
# Rows are grouped chunk_rows at a time, and the chunk results are then added up,
# since a group can span chunks. Only the needed columns of each chunk are copied.
# data.table is not attached, so it does not mask lubridate's hour() and year()
# or dplyr's between()
collapse_trips <- function(trips, end, duration = FALSE) {
  keys <- c("yearmonth", "date", end)
  cols <- unclass(trips)[c(keys, if (duration) "trip_minutes")]
  n <- nrow(trips)
  chunks <- lapply(seq(1, n, by = chunk_rows), function(first) {
    rows <- first:min(first + chunk_rows - 1, n)
    counts <- count_trips(data.table::setDT(lapply(cols, `[`, rows)), keys, duration)
    gc() # release the chunk's copied columns before the next chunk
    counts
  })
  collapsed <- data.table::rbindlist(chunks)
  rm(chunks)
  collapsed <- if (duration) {
    collapsed[, .(trips = sum(trips), trip_duration_mins = sum(trip_duration_mins)), by = keys]
  } else {
    collapsed[, .(trips = sum(trips)), by = keys]
  }
  gc()
  as_tibble(collapsed) %>%
    rename(comarea_id = all_of(end))
}

collapse_both_ends <- function(trips, duration = FALSE) {
  list(start = collapse_trips(trips, "start_comarea_id", duration),
       end = collapse_trips(trips, "end_comarea_id", duration))
}

trips_collapsed <- collapse_both_ends(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all)
duration_collapsed <- collapse_both_ends(divvy_trips_2013_2026_ca_all_duration, duration = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: create summary tables

comarea_ids <- sort(community_areas$comarea_id)

# add up trips (and, for the duration tables, minutes) within groups of collapsed rows
summarise_trips <- function(grouped, duration) {
  if (duration) {
    summarise(grouped, trips = sum(trips), trip_duration_mins = sum(trip_duration_mins), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    summarise(grouped, trips = sum(trips), .groups = "drop")
  }
}

# trips by a time period ("yearmonth" or "date"); either end holds every trip
sum_by_period <- function(collapsed, period, duration = FALSE) {
  collapsed$start %>%
    drop_na(all_of(period)) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(period))) %>%
    summarise_trips(duration)
}

# trips from (fr_) and to (to_) each community area by a time period;
# community area / period combinations without trips are filled with 0
sum_by_period_ca <- function(collapsed, period, duration = FALSE) {
  by_end <- function(end, prefix) {
    collapsed[[end]] %>%
      drop_na(all_of(c(period, "comarea_id"))) %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(c(period, "comarea_id")))) %>%
      summarise_trips(duration) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(prefix, .x), -all_of(c(period, "comarea_id")))
  }
  zeros <- list(fr_trips = 0L, to_trips = 0L)
  if (duration) zeros <- c(zeros, list(fr_trip_duration_mins = 0, to_trip_duration_mins = 0))
  
  full_join(by_end("start", "fr_"),
            by_end("end", "to_"),
            by = c(period, "comarea_id")) %>%
    filter(comarea_id %in% comarea_ids) %>%
    complete(!!sym(period), comarea_id = comarea_ids, fill = zeros)
}

# trip counts
trips_by_yearmonth <- sum_by_period(trips_collapsed, "yearmonth") %>%
  transmute(yearmonth = ym(yearmonth), trips) %>%
  arrange(yearmonth) %>%
  mutate(trips_cumul = cumsum(trips))

trips_by_date <- sum_by_period(trips_collapsed, "date") %>%
  transmute(date = mdy(date), trips) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(trips_cumul = cumsum(trips))

trips_by_yearmonth_ca <- sum_by_period_ca(trips_collapsed, "yearmonth") %>%
  transmute(yearmonth = ym(yearmonth), comarea_id, fr_trips, to_trips) %>%
  arrange(yearmonth, comarea_id) %>%
  group_by(comarea_id) %>%
  mutate(fr_trips_cumul = cumsum(fr_trips),
         to_trips_cumul = cumsum(to_trips)) %>%
  ungroup()

# average trip duration (minutes per trip)
duration_by_yearmonth <- sum_by_period(duration_collapsed, "yearmonth", duration = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(yearmonth = ym(yearmonth),
         mins_per_trip = trip_duration_mins / trips) %>%
  arrange(yearmonth)

duration_by_date <- sum_by_period(duration_collapsed, "date", duration = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(date = mdy(date),
         mins_per_trip = trip_duration_mins / trips) %>%
  arrange(date)

# trips from (fr_) and to (to_) each community area; NA where no trips occurred
duration_by_yearmonth_ca <- sum_by_period_ca(duration_collapsed, "yearmonth", duration = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(yearmonth = ym(yearmonth),
         fr_mins_per_trip = if_else(fr_trips > 0, fr_trip_duration_mins / fr_trips, NA_real_),
         to_mins_per_trip = if_else(to_trips > 0, to_trip_duration_mins / to_trips, NA_real_)) %>%
  arrange(yearmonth, comarea_id) %>%
  select(yearmonth, comarea_id,
         fr_trips, fr_trip_duration_mins, fr_mins_per_trip,
         to_trips, to_trip_duration_mins, to_mins_per_trip)
```

## Socioeconomic Status
```{r}
a_topic_list <- c("population", "SVI","poverty", "inactivity", "mortality", "transit", "violence") # edit here
a_chicago_topic_keys <- c("POP", "SVI", "POV","HCSPAP","VRDTHR","HCSWTSP","HCSNVP") # edit here
a_period_list <- c("2020-2024", "2022", "2020-2024","2016-2018","2020-2024","2023-2024","2023-2024") # edit here

# download Chicago health survey indicators
for (i in 1:length(a_chicago_topic_keys)){

  atopic_key <- a_chicago_topic_keys[i]
  atopic_name <- a_topic_list[i]
  aperiod <- a_period_list[i]
  
  #print(atopic_name)
  
  a_table_name <- paste0("chicago_indicator_",atopic_name)

  a_topic_url <- paste0("https://chicagohealthatlas.org/api/v1/data/?format=json&layer=neighborhood&period=",aperiod,"&population=&topic=",atopic_key)
  
  a_topic_json <- fromJSON(a_topic_url)

  a_topic_df <- a_topic_json$results %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(estimate = v,
         se = se,
         geoid = g,
         layer = l) %>%
    mutate(topic = atopic_name,
           geoid= as.integer(str_replace(geoid,"1714000-",""))) %>% 
    drop_na(geoid)

  assign(a_table_name, a_topic_df)
  
}

# bind SCC and Chicago indicators together
apattern <- "chicago_indicator_"
alist_indicators <- mget(ls(pattern=apattern))
indicators_all <- rbindlist(alist_indicators) 
community_areas_ses <- indicators_all %>% 
  select(-c(se,layer),
         comarea_id = geoid) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = topic, values_from = estimate) %>% 
  right_join(community_areas, by="comarea_id") %>% 
  st_as_sf() %>% 
  st_transform(crs=4326)

# remove unneeded tables
rm(list=ls(pattern=apattern))

```

## Divvy Stations
Divvy publishes its system information as a [General Bikeshare Feed Specification](https://gbfs.org) (GBFS) feed. The GBFS index (`gbfs.json`) lists the URLs of the system's feeds. Station locations are in the `station_information` feed, as latitude and longitude values, which are converted to points.

```{r}
#| label: import divvy stations

# GBFS index: one list of feeds per language
gbfs_index <- fromJSON("https://gbfs.divvybikes.com/gbfs/2.3/gbfs.json")
gbfs_feeds <- gbfs_index$data[[1]]$feeds
station_information_url <- gbfs_feeds$url[gbfs_feeds$name == "station_information"]

# current stations as points, with the community area each is in (NA outside Chicago)
divvy_stations <- fromJSON(station_information_url)$data$stations %>%
  select(any_of(c("short_name", "name", "capacity", "lat", "lon"))) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>% # GBFS coordinates are WGS 84
  st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
  st_join(community_areas %>%
            st_transform(crs = 4326) %>%
            select(comarea_id, comarea_name),
          join = st_within)

# date the station feed was downloaded, used to label maps in Exercise_02.qmd
divvy_stations_date <- Sys.Date()
```


# Create Exercise_02.RData file
`Exercise_02.qmd` loads this file. The CARTO API key comes from the `CARTO_API_KEY` environment variable (e.g., set in `.Renviron`) unless it is already defined in the session.

## Functions for Exercise #2

```{r}
#| label: exercise functions

# function for adding the selected indicator's values (ses_value) and quintile
# categories (ses_ntile) to community areas
fx_add_ses_quintiles <- function(community_areas_ses, ses_column) {
  quintile_labels <- c("Lowest", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Highest")
  community_areas_ses %>%
    mutate(ses_value = .data[[ses_column]],
           ses_ntile = quintile_labels[ntile(ses_value, 5)])
}

# function for adding Divvy stations as two layers: every station as a single point
# (hidden when the map opens) and docks grouped into clusters that show the total
# number of docks they contain (shown when the map opens). Points without a reported capacity are
# likely single, free-floating bikes rather than stations, so they are left out of
# the dock clusters. Stations are drawn in their own pane, above the community areas
fx_add_station_layers <- function(map, divvy_stations) {

  # station hover labels
  station_labels <- sprintf(
    "<strong>%s</strong><br/>
    <i>Docks:</i> %s<br/>
    <i>Community area:</i> %s",
    divvy_stations$name,
    if_else(is.na(divvy_stations$capacity),
            "not reported (likely a free-floating bike)",
            as.character(divvy_stations$capacity)),
    coalesce(divvy_stations$comarea_name, "Outside Chicago")) %>%
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)

  # stations with a reported number of docks
  docked <- !is.na(divvy_stations$capacity)
  docked_stations <- divvy_stations[docked, ]

  # dock counts passed to the cluster icons, keyed by each station's coordinates;
  # stations that share coordinates split their combined docks equally, so the
  # cluster totals add up
  coords <- st_coordinates(docked_stations)
  coord_key <- sprintf("%.6f,%.6f", coords[, "Y"], coords[, "X"])
  dock_share <- tapply(docked_stations$capacity, coord_key, sum) /
    tapply(docked_stations$capacity, coord_key, length)
  dock_lookup <- jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(dock_share), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA)

  # cluster icons: steelblue circles showing the total docks of the stations in each
  # cluster (single stations included), sized to fit the number
  dock_icon <- htmlwidgets::JS(paste0("
    (function() {
      var docks = ", dock_lookup, ";
      return function(cluster) {
        var total = 0;
        cluster.getAllChildMarkers().forEach(function(m) {
          var ll = m.getLatLng();
          total += docks[ll.lat.toFixed(6) + ',' + ll.lng.toFixed(6)] || 0;
        });
        var text = Math.round(total).toLocaleString('en-US');
        var size = Math.max(32, 14 + 8 * text.length);
        return new L.DivIcon({
          html: '<div style=\"background-color: rgba(70, 130, 180, 0.85); color: white; font-weight: bold; border: 2px solid white; border-radius: 50%; width: ' + size + 'px; height: ' + size + 'px; line-height: ' + (size - 4) + 'px; text-align: center;\">' + text + '</div>',
          className: '',
          iconSize: new L.Point(size, size)
        });
      };
    })()"))

  map %>%
    addMapPane("stations", zIndex = 450) %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = divvy_stations,
      radius = 5,
      color = "#fff",
      weight = 1,
      fillColor = "steelblue",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      label = station_labels,
      options = pathOptions(pane = "stations"),
      group = "Divvy Stations") %>%
    addMarkers(
      data = docked_stations,
      label = station_labels[docked],
      clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
        showCoverageOnHover = FALSE, # no outline of the cluster's area on hover
        singleMarkerMode = TRUE, # single stations also show their docks
        iconCreateFunction = dock_icon),
      group = "Divvy Docks (clustered)") %>%
    hideGroup("Divvy Stations")
}

# function for mapping the selected indicator by community area (quintiles) with
# Divvy stations; the layer control turns the indicator (and its legend), the
# stations and the dock clusters on and off
fx_map_ses_quintiles <- function(trips_by_communityarea_ses, divvy_stations, ses_name, total_days) {
  map_pal <- fx_quintile_pal(trips_by_communityarea_ses$ses_value)

  fx_basemap(trips_by_communityarea_ses) %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~map_pal(ses_value),
      label = fx_communityarea_labels(trips_by_communityarea_ses, total_days, ses_name),
      weight = 2,
      opacity = 1,
      color = "white",
      dashArray = "3",
      fillOpacity = 0.7,
      group = ses_name) %>%
    addLegend("bottomleft",
              pal = map_pal,
              values = ~ses_value,
              title = paste0(ses_name, "<br>Quintiles"),
              opacity = 1,
              group = ses_name) %>%
    fx_add_station_layers(divvy_stations) %>%
    addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c(ses_name, "Divvy Stations", "Divvy Docks (clustered)"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, position = "topright"))
}

# quintile category colors, from Highest to Lowest (also used in Step 6)
quintile_colors <- c(Highest = "darkred",
                     High = "orange",
                     Moderate = "yellow",
                     Low = "lightblue",
                     Lowest = "darkblue")

# function for summarizing trips by year, month and quintile category of the
# selected indicator (added to community areas with fx_add_ses_quintiles)
fx_summarise_trips_by_ses <- function(trips_by_yearmonth_ca, community_areas_ses, total_days) {
  trips_by_yearmonth_ca %>%
    left_join(community_areas_ses %>% st_drop_geometry(), by = "comarea_id") %>%
    group_by(yearmonth, ses_ntile) %>%
    summarise(tot_pop = sum(population),
              fr_trips = sum(fr_trips),
              to_trips = sum(to_trips),
              fr_trips_cumul = sum(fr_trips_cumul),
              to_trips_cumul = sum(to_trips_cumul),
              fr_dailytrips = fr_trips/total_days,
              to_dailytrips = to_trips/total_days,
              fr_trips_per10k = fr_trips/tot_pop*10000,
              to_trips_per10k = to_trips/tot_pop*10000,
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    drop_na(tot_pop) %>%
    mutate(order = case_when(ses_ntile == "Lowest" ~ 1,
                             ses_ntile == "Low" ~ 2,
                             ses_ntile == "Moderate" ~ 3,
                             ses_ntile == "High" ~ 4,
                             ses_ntile == "Highest" ~ 5),
           ses_label = factor(ses_ntile, levels = names(quintile_colors))) %>%
    arrange(yearmonth, order)
}

# function for plotting monthly trips per 10,000 residents by quintile category;
# ses_name labels the legend
fx_plot_trips_by_ses <- function(trips_by_yearmonth_by_ses, ses_name = "Indicator") {
  plot_ly(data = trips_by_yearmonth_by_ses,
          x = ~yearmonth,
          y = ~fr_trips_per10k,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          color = ~ses_label,
          colors = unname(quintile_colors),
          text = ~ses_label,
          hovertemplate = '%{text}: %{y:0.1f}<extra></extra>') %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtons = list(list("toImage", "resetScale2d")),
           toImageButtonOptions = list(filename = paste0("divvy_trips_by_", tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", ses_name)), "_quintile"))) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Monthly Divvy Trips (from) per 10,000 Residents"),
      legend = list(
        title = list(text = paste0(ses_name, " Quintile  ")),
        font = list(size = 10),
        xanchor = "center",
        orientation = "h",
        x = 0.5, y = -0.1),
      hovermode = "x unified")
}

# function for summarizing population and trips by quintile category of the
# selected indicator, from Highest to Lowest
fx_summarise_ses_quintiles <- function(trips_by_yearmonth_by_ses) {
  trips_by_yearmonth_by_ses %>%
    group_by(ses_ntile) %>%
    summarise(order = max(order),
              tot_pop = max(tot_pop),
              fr_trips = sum(fr_trips),
              to_trips = sum(to_trips)) %>%
    mutate(tot_pop_pct = tot_pop/sum(tot_pop),
           fr_trips_pct = fr_trips/sum(fr_trips),
           to_trips_pct = to_trips/sum(to_trips)) %>%
    arrange(-order) %>%
    select(-order)
}

# function for formatting the summary table as an interactive table; ses_name
# labels the quintile column
fx_table_ses_quintiles <- function(trips_by_ses_quintile, ses_name = "Indicator") {
  trips_by_ses_quintile %>%
    datatable(class = 'cell-border stripe',
              selection = "none", 
              rownames = FALSE,
              colnames = c(paste(ses_name, "Quintile"), "Total Population", "Trips (from)", "Trips (to)",
                           "Percent of Population", "Percent of Trips (from)", "Percent of Trips (to)"),
              options = list(searching = FALSE,
                             lengthChange = FALSE,
                             paging = FALSE)) %>%
    formatPercentage(c("tot_pop_pct", "fr_trips_pct", "to_trips_pct"), digits = 1) %>%
    formatRound(c("tot_pop", "fr_trips", "to_trips"), mark = ",", digits = 0)
}

# function for looking up the selected community areas, their quintile categories
# and colors (from Highest to Lowest)
fx_select_communityareas <- function(community_areas_ses, selected_communityareas, colors = quintile_colors) {
  community_areas_ses %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(comarea_name %in% selected_communityareas) %>%
    select(comarea_id, comarea_name, ses_ntile) %>%
    mutate(ses_label = factor(ses_ntile, levels = names(colors)),
           ca_label = paste0(comarea_name, " (", ses_ntile, ")"),
           color = unname(colors[as.character(ses_ntile)])) %>%
    arrange(ses_label)
}

# function for plotting monthly trips (from) for the selected community areas
fx_plot_trips_selected <- function(trips_by_yearmonth_ca, selected_ca) {
  trips_by_yearmonth_selected <- trips_by_yearmonth_ca %>%
    inner_join(selected_ca, by = "comarea_id") %>%
    mutate(ca_label = factor(ca_label, levels = selected_ca$ca_label))

  plot_ly(data = trips_by_yearmonth_selected,
          x = ~yearmonth,
          y = ~fr_trips,
          type = 'scatter',
          mode = 'lines',
          color = ~ca_label,
          colors = setNames(selected_ca$color, selected_ca$ca_label),
          text = ~ca_label,
          hovertemplate = '%{text}: %{y:,}<extra></extra>') %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtons = list(list("toImage", "resetScale2d")),
           toImageButtonOptions = list(filename = "divvy_trips_by_yearmonth_selected_communityareas")) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = ""),
      yaxis = list(title = "Monthly Divvy Trips (from)"),
      legend = list(
        title = list(text = "Community Area (Quintile)  "),
        font = list(size = 10),
        orientation = "h",
        xanchor = "center",
        x = 0.5, y = -0.1),
      hovermode = "x unified")
}

# function for plotting a box plot of monthly average trip duration (from) for
# the selected community areas
fx_plot_duration_selected <- function(duration_by_yearmonth_ca, selected_ca) {
  duration_by_yearmonth_selected <- duration_by_yearmonth_ca %>%
    inner_join(selected_ca, by = "comarea_id") %>%
    mutate(ca_label = factor(ca_label, levels = selected_ca$ca_label))

  plot_ly(data = duration_by_yearmonth_selected,
          x = ~ca_label,
          y = ~fr_mins_per_trip,
          type = 'box',
          boxpoints = "outliers", # whiskers extend to 1.5 x IQR; months beyond them are plotted as points
          color = ~ca_label,
          colors = setNames(selected_ca$color, selected_ca$ca_label)) %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           modeBarButtons = list(list("toImage", "resetScale2d")),
           toImageButtonOptions = list(filename = "divvy_trip_duration_selected_communityareas")) %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Community Area (Quintile)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Average Trip Duration (Minutes per Trip)",
                   hoverformat = ".1f"), # hover values to tenths
      showlegend = FALSE)
}
```
